name: Wildcard March of the Dead raises a marching line of zombies that explode on an enemy (#10616)
contract: March of the Dead 280510 reads 'Spend rage to summon a line of undead at the target location for $d. Each undead marches forward, exploding when it reaches an enemy and dealing damage to nearby enemies.' Its effect is SCRIPT_EFFECT with 5+1 creatures 280511 and SummonProperties 61, a copy of the Necromancer's 707007.
Creature 280511 had no template and nothing handled the script effect, so the cast spent rage and did nothing.

Expected: six zombies appear, march to the enemy 12 yd ahead and explode with 280512 (560 Plague damage in 5 yd, -72% movement speed in 8 yd for 3 s): the enemy is damaged and slowed and the zombies are gone.
